official_rubric.note: The category estimates below are evaluator judgments from submitted and fresh local evidence, not official judge scores. Creative AI is unscored because complete main-session prompt/response logs are not in these packages. No total is assigned.

post_bypass_boundary_issue.behavior: The detector ignores the first input sample after bypass ends. A new trigger sequence beginning on that sample is missed; beginning one sample later works.
post_bypass_boundary_issue.coverage_gap: The existing retrigger-2x case does not start its second trigger at the first post-bypass sample.
post_bypass_boundary_issue.recommended_check: Add directed sequences beginning at the first and second post-bypass samples, compare activation count and 128-frame bypass windows to a corrected reference, then rerun full regression and synthesis.
